title: Bloody Bites
description:
S18 E07 — Queen of Sod; Slashr
While researching a book on Hollywood urban legends, Mike Campbell lands an interview with the son of "The Queen of Sod"; a young man named Ashkan is stalked by a killer known for deceiving his victims into sharing their locations on a dating app.

title: Bloody Bites
description:
S18 E01 — The Blue Diamond
Attending her estranged, narcissistic mother's funeral, grieving Alison discovers Jacqueline ran off to a mountain town to open an 80s après-ski club, but the club's cultish, robotic members in ski suits aren't just weird locals.

title: Bloody Bites
description:
S18 E02 — Banjo
Isaac is thrilled when his friend offers him the use of his family's cabin in the woods to lose his virginity; but when his first time goes horribly wrong, he begins to believe it may be the work of a cult.

title: Bloody Bites
description:
S18 E03 — Escape; Obey!
Awakening on the floor of a destroyed suburban bedroom, a global invasion has begun, and the protagonist is not alone in the house; after the death of her dog Max, a pet influencer is confronted by a vengeful spirit demanding an apology.

title: Bloody Bites
description:
S07 E01 — Air Conditions
An easy job turns into a struggle for survival for a HVAC repair man; stuck to the roof, he must escape before night falls and the real horror begins.

description:

description: Flashbacks reveal a woman's (Tilda Swinton) calamitous efforts to raise her firstborn son while, in the present, she grapples with the aftermath of the youth's horrific act.

description: Tattooed by a Bushman, a Soviet officer (Dolph Lundgren) leads an overthrow of Soviet/Cuban troops in Africa.

description: A mad scientist tries to revive his dead daughter by an operation, but there are certain body parts he needs that he can't get. His problem is solved when a group of drunken partygoers stumble into his castle.

title: The Island
description:
S01 E03 — Accomplices
As outsiders and insiders start to gather on the island, personal lives grow increasingly complex; the first casualties of the virus are made known.

title: The Island
description:
S01 E04 — Probabilities
Local authorities send a pandemic commissioner to take control of the island; Mayor Østergaard and Officer Mikkel don't like the new initiatives.

title: Tales From The Void
description:
S01 E03 — Starlight
Whit Barnett is obsessed with the idea of being famous; he devotes all his energy toward a vlog, and reality shows are a mainstay in his apartment.

title: The Trouble With Tessa
description:
S01 E03 — Part Three: The Bone King
Tessa comes clean about why they ran away to Lowery and agrees to meet Freddy before curfew; watching another tape allows Tessa to see Amelia's face for the first time; Tessa has a terrifying encounter with a figure from the bar.

title: Creature From the Haunted Sea
description: After political unrest breaks out on a Caribbean island, scheming criminal Renzo Capetto (Anthony Carbone) promises to transport a group of exiles out of the country while also taking part of the national treasury.

title: Mermaid Down
description: A mermaid is pulled from the water, has her fin cut off, and is sent to a mental home when no one believes she is really a mermaid.

title: Il demonio
description: Purificazione curses Antonio when he chooses to marry someone else, inciting the townspeople to believe she is a witch.

title: Ice Cream Man
description: Some children alert the police to a disturbed vendor who blends human parts into his frozen confections.

title: The Collector
description: A desperate man plans to break into his wealthy employer's house, then learns that another thief has beaten him to it and rigged the place with deadly traps.

title: The Innkeepers
description: During the final days at the Yankee Pedlar Inn, two employees determined to reveal the hotel's haunted past begin to experience disturbing events as old guests check in for a stay.

title: Heavy Trip
description: A young man is trying to overcome his fears by leading an unknown heavy metal band to the hottest metal festival in Norway. The journey includes heavy metal, grave robbing, Viking heaven, and an armed conflict between Finland and Norway.

title: The Beyond
description: Gruesome deaths occur when a woman (Katherine MacColl) inherits a hotel that is one of seven gateways to hell.
